designs.title: Charades Indoor Activity Segmentation
designs.description: Multi-label temporal activity segmentation in indoor home videos. Annotators identify action instances using compositional verb-object labels (e.g., 'opening door', 'sitting on chair') with precise temporal boundaries.

designs.name: epic-kitchens-egocentric
designs.title: EPIC-KITCHENS Egocentric Action Annotation
designs.description: Annotate fine-grained actions in egocentric kitchen videos with verb-noun pairs. Identify cooking actions from a first-person perspective.

designs.name: finediving-procedure-aqa
designs.title: FineDiving: Procedure-aware Action Quality Assessment
designs.description: Fine-grained diving action quality assessment. Annotators mark a dive and its consecutive sub-action steps on the timeline, then record the dive type, difficulty degree, and scores (Xu et al., CVPR 2022).

designs.name: finegym-action-segments
designs.title: FineGym Dataset: Fine-Grained Gymnastics Action Recognition
designs.description: FineGym is a hierarchical video dataset (CVPR 2020) for fine-grained gymnastics action recognition: events, sets, and 99-530 element classes annotated with millisecond-level temporal boundaries. See the label taxonomy and a runnable Potato config to annotate or extend it.

designs.name: fisv-figure-skating-scoring
designs.title: Fis-V: Figure Skating Video Scoring
designs.description: Automatic figure skating scoring as video regression. Annotators mark the technical elements and record the Total Element Score (TES) and Total Program Component Score (PCS) for a ladies' short program (Xu et al., IEEE TCSVT 2020).

designs.name: soccernet-action-spotting
designs.title: SoccerNet Action Spotting: The 17 Soccer Action Classes
designs.description: SoccerNet-v2 defines 17 action spotting classes (goal, corner, card, foul, substitution, and more) with 110,458 labeled events across 500 broadcast games. Full class list, dataset and paper links, and a Potato config to reproduce the task.
designs.paper_reference: Giancola et al., CVPR 2018; Deliege et al. 2021 (SoccerNet-v2)

designs.name: thumos14-action-localization
designs.title: THUMOS14 Action Localization
designs.description: Temporal action localization in untrimmed sports videos. Annotators identify precise start and end times of 20 sports action classes in YouTube videos.

designs.name: ami-meeting-annotation
designs.title: AMI Meeting Multi-Tier Annotation
designs.description: Multi-tier ELAN-style annotation of multi-party meeting recordings. Annotators segment speaker turns, head gestures, and focus of attention on parallel timeline tiers, then classify dialogue acts and topic segments. Based on the AMI Meeting Corpus.

designs.name: moviescenes-detection
designs.title: MovieScenes Scene Detection
designs.description: Detect and annotate scene boundaries in movies. Identify where semantic scene changes occur based on location, time, or narrative shifts.

designs.name: scene-boundary-detection
designs.title: Scene Boundary Detection
designs.description: Identify scene boundaries in documentary and narrative videos. Annotators mark transitions between semantically coherent scenes based on visual, audio, and narrative cues.

designs.name: shot-boundary-detection
designs.title: TRECVID Shot Boundary Detection
designs.description: Detect shot boundaries and classify transition types in broadcast video. Mark cuts, dissolves, fades, and other transitions between camera shots.
designs.paper_reference: Smeaton, Over & Doherty, Computer Vision and Image Understanding 2010

designs.name: childes-child-language
designs.title: CHILDES Child Language Multi-Tier Annotation
designs.description: Multi-tier ELAN-style annotation of child-adult interaction videos for language acquisition research. Annotators segment utterance boundaries on the timeline, provide morphological and syntactic annotations, and classify communicative context and error types. Based on the CHILDES/TalkBank project.

designs.name: cmu-mosei-multimodal-sentiment
designs.title: CMU-MOSEI: Multimodal Sentiment and Emotion Dataset
designs.description: CMU-MOSEI is the largest multimodal dataset for sentiment and emotion analysis, with 23,453 annotated YouTube clips spanning text, audio, and video. This Potato config reproduces its multi-tier timeline annotation.

designs.name: dgs-corpus-sign-language
designs.title: DGS Corpus Sign Language Multi-Tier Annotation
designs.description: Multi-tier ELAN-style annotation of German Sign Language (DGS) corpus videos. Annotators segment sign types, mouth gestures, non-manual signals, classify discourse functions, and provide German translations across parallel tiers aligned to the video timeline.
designs.task_name: DGS Corpus Sign Language Multi-Tier Annotation

designs.name: ego4d-episodic-memory
designs.title: Ego4D: Egocentric Video Episodic Memory Annotation
designs.description: Annotate egocentric (first-person) video for episodic memory tasks including activity segmentation, hand state tracking, natural language query generation, and scene narration. Supports temporal segment annotation with multiple label tiers for the Ego4D benchmark.

designs.name: finesports-action-recognition
designs.title: FineSports: Fine-grained Basketball Action Recognition
designs.description: Fine-grained NBA basketball action recognition. Annotators track the ball-handler across a clip and label a two-level hierarchy of 12 coarse ball-handler actions and 52 fine-grained sub-actions (Xu et al., CVPR 2024).

designs.name: harmony4d-interaction-tracking
designs.title: Harmony4D Human Interaction Tracking
designs.description: Close-range human interaction tracking and annotation. Annotators track multiple people during close physical interactions (dancing, martial arts, collaborative tasks) with bounding boxes and interaction labels.

designs.name: how2sign-sign-language
designs.title: How2Sign Sign Language Multi-Tier Annotation
designs.description: Multi-tier ELAN-style annotation of continuous American Sign Language videos. Annotators segment sign glosses, mark mouthing patterns, classify sign handedness, and provide English translations aligned to video timelines. Based on the How2Sign large-scale multimodal ASL dataset.

designs.name: iemocap-dyadic-emotion
designs.title: IEMOCAP: Dyadic Emotion Recognition Dataset
designs.description: IEMOCAP is a 12-hour audiovisual corpus of two-actor emotional conversations with categorical and dimensional emotion labels. This Potato config reproduces its per-speaker tagging on parallel timeline tiers.
designs.paper_reference: Busso et al., Language Resources and Evaluation 2008

designs.name: howto100m-instructional
designs.title: HowTo100M Instructional Video Annotation
designs.description: Annotate instructional video clips with step descriptions and visual grounding. Link narrated instructions to visual actions for video-language understanding.

designs.name: youcook2-instructional
designs.title: YouCook2 Dataset: Cooking Video Recipe-Step Annotation
designs.description: YouCook2 contains 2,000 cooking videos across 89 recipes (176 hours), each segmented into recipe steps with temporal boundaries and imperative captions (AAAI 2018). Dataset and paper links plus a Potato config for procedural video annotation.

designs.name: msad-anomaly-detection
designs.title: MSAD Multi-Scenario Anomaly Detection
designs.description: Video anomaly detection across multiple scenarios. Annotators watch surveillance-style videos and mark temporal segments containing anomalous events, classifying the anomaly type.

designs.name: saga-gesture-speech
designs.title: SaGA Gesture-Speech Alignment Multi-Tier Annotation
designs.description: Multi-tier ELAN-style annotation of co-speech gestures and their alignment with spoken language. Annotators segment gesture phases and types on parallel timeline tiers, classify handedness and spatial reference frames, and transcribe concurrent speech. Based on the SaGA corpus.
designs.paper_reference: Lücking et al., Journal on Multimodal User Interfaces 2013

designs.name: movienet-scene-classification
designs.title: MovieNet: Holistic Movie Understanding Dataset
designs.description: MovieNet is a 1,100-movie dataset from Huang et al. (ECCV 2020) with scene, place, action, and cinematic-style annotations. This Potato config reproduces its scene classification labeling task.

designs.name: davis-video-object-segmentation
designs.title: DAVIS - Video Object Segmentation with Mask Propagation
designs.description: Semi-supervised video object segmentation on DAVIS (Pont-Tuset et al., 2017): mask each object on the first frame, then propagate it through the clip with SAM 2 and correct the frames where it drifts.

designs.name: lsmdc-keyframe-selection
designs.title: LSMDC Keyframe Selection
designs.description: Select representative keyframes from movie clips for video description tasks. Annotators identify frames that best summarize the visual content of each shot.

designs.name: summe-summarization
designs.title: SumMe Video Summarization
designs.description: Create video summaries by selecting key segments that best represent the content. Annotators identify important moments for automatic video summarization research.

designs.name: tvsum-summarization
designs.title: TVSum Video Summarization
designs.description: Frame-level importance scoring for video summarization. Annotators rate 2-second shots on a 1-5 importance scale to identify key moments worth including in a summary.

designs.name: youtube-highlights
designs.title: YouTube Highlights Detection
designs.description: Detect highlight-worthy moments in domain-specific videos. Annotators identify the most engaging segments for automatic highlight generation.

designs.name: activitynet-captions
designs.title: ActivityNet Captions: Dense Video Captioning Dataset
designs.description: ActivityNet Captions pairs 20k untrimmed videos with 100k temporally localized sentence descriptions for dense-captioning research. This Potato config reproduces the segment-and-describe workflow.

designs.name: charades-sta-grounding
designs.title: Charades-STA Temporal Grounding
designs.description: Ground natural language descriptions to video segments. Given a sentence describing an action, identify the exact temporal boundaries where that action occurs.

designs.name: didemo-moment-retrieval
designs.title: DiDeMo Moment Retrieval
designs.description: Localizing natural language descriptions to specific video moments. Given a text query, annotators identify the corresponding temporal segment in the video.

designs.name: qvhighlights-moment-saliency
designs.title: QVHighlights Moment Grounding and Saliency
designs.description: Query-based moment localization and highlight rating based on the QVHighlights dataset (Lei, Berg, Bansal, NeurIPS 2021). Given a free-form natural-language event query, annotators mark the relevant moment interval(s) in the video with the dedicated temporal_grounding scheme, seeing a live IoU against a model's predicted interval when one is provided, and then rate the clip's saliency on the paper's five-point scale from Very Good to Very Bad.

designs.name: vbench-generation-quality
designs.title: VBench: Video Generation Quality Benchmark
designs.description: VBench (CVPR 2024) breaks text-to-video quality into 16 evaluation dimensions, from temporal flickering to text alignment. This Potato config reproduces the human preference ratings VBench uses to validate those dimensions.

designs.name: video-chatgpt-qa-display
designs.title: Video-ChatGPT - Video QA Display and Evaluation
designs.description: Video question answering evaluation based on the Video-ChatGPT benchmark (Maaz et al., ACL 2024). Annotators watch a video, review a model-generated response to a question, and evaluate correctness and quality.
designs.task_name: Video-ChatGPT - Video QA Display and Evaluation

designs.name: mvbench-video-understanding
designs.title: MVBench Video Understanding
designs.description: Comprehensive video understanding benchmark with multiple-choice questions, video segment annotation, and reasoning, based on MVBench (Li et al., CVPR 2024). Tests temporal perception, action recognition, and state change detection in videos.

designs.name: nextqa-temporal
designs.title: NExT-QA: Causal and Temporal Video QA Benchmark
designs.description: NExT-QA (Xiao et al., CVPR 2021) is a video QA benchmark for causal and temporal action reasoning over 5,440 videos and ~52K questions. This Potato config reproduces its multiple-choice answer task.

designs.name: vstar-video-dialogue
designs.title: VSTAR Video-grounded Dialogue
designs.description: Video-grounded dialogue annotation. Annotators watch videos and answer questions requiring situated understanding, write dialogue turns grounded in specific video moments, and mark relevant temporal segments.
